evals.prompt: Review feedback arrived on my ~/work/billing-api proration PR: (1) the rounding helper duplicates `cents()` in utils, (2) 'this file is too long', (3) a claim that the change breaks yearly plans — but we have no yearly plans. Respond to the review.
evals.expected_output: Verifies each finding on its merits first: accepts and fixes the duplication, asks what specifically is too long (or declines the vague one with reasons), and refutes the yearly-plans claim with evidence — editing only what the verified findings support.

evals.prompt: Nobody has reviewed my ~/work/billing-api PR yet and CI is red with a lint error. Respond to the review findings.
evals.expected_output: Points out there is no review to receive (and fixes the lint failure as ordinary diagnosis) instead of inventing feedback to process.
